# Wastelanders plans listed among raiders / settlers by merchants and reputation / gold plans of all factions

![Wastelander's plans for raiders / settlers listed by merchants and reputation / gold plans of all factions](/uploads/55_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update January 14, 2026] New plan for Samuel & Regs from patch 66

*Note: New plans are marked in **bold***

Depending on which **reputation level** you have achieved with the **Raiders** or **Settlers**, you will receive different offers. The higher the reputation level, the more offers are available.

There are the following dealers:

Vault 79 (Secret Service): **Regs**

Raider: **Mortimer (in Crater Core)**, **Molly, Ae-Ri**

Settlers: **Sunny**, **Samuel (Foundation)**

Additionally, there is **Minerva**, which offers changing plans from both factions. Minerva's offer and dates can be found here.

You can buy all of Reg's plans immediately after the Vault 79 raid. The Settlers and Raiders plans are released as follows:
